inclusion_rule: Include studies that train a multimodal speech model (audio-visual or other paired modalities) while randomly withholding one input modality for whole training examples or sequences (modality dropout), so the model also works from either modality alone. Boundary: frame-level masking inside one modality, ordinary feature dropout, and papers that only cite modality dropout without using it are excluded; counts are pattern match over ledger text and full text (reference lists removed), grouped into unique studies by title.
